# 9.01 The order of additions in the reduction tree of a block
Part: the order of additions in the reduction tree of a block
Clause: PMPP 5th ed. §10.2 Reduction trees, PMPP 5th ed. §10.4 Reducing control divergence
After: none
Levels: c++23
Device: yes
Source: Programming Massively Parallel Processors, 5th ed. (Hwu, Kirk, El Hajj), ch. 10, §10.2 and §10.4

## Example
```cuda
#include <cuda/std/span>
#include <print>

__global__ void tree(cuda::std::span<float> a)
{
    unsigned t {threadIdx.x};
    //: Add element t + h to element t, for h = 4, then 2, then 1.
    for (unsigned h {blockDim.x / 2}; h > 0; h /= 2) {
        if (t < h) {
            a[t] += a[t + h];
        }
        //: Finish every addition of a step before the next step.
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

int main()
{
    //: Put eight floats where the device can read them.
    float x[8] {1e8f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f, -1e8f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f};
    float* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, sizeof x);
    for (int i {0}; i < 8; ++i) {
        a[i] = x[i];
    }
    //: Add them from left to right on the host.
    float serial {0.0f};
    for (float v : x) {
        serial += v;
    }
    //: Add them by the tree in one block of eight threads.
    tree<<<1, 8>>>(cuda::std::span<float> {a, 8});
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    //: Print both sums: the tree adds 1e8 to -1e8 first.
    std::println("{:.0f} {:.0f}", a[0], serial);
    cudaFree(a);
}
```

## Verdict 1
Sanitizer: racecheck
```cuda
#include <cuda/std/span>
#include <print>

__global__ void tree(cuda::std::span<float> a)
{
    __shared__ float s[256];
    unsigned t {threadIdx.x};
    s[t] = a[t];
    __syncthreads();
    for (unsigned h {128}; h > 0; h /= 2) {
        if (t < h) {
            s[t] += s[t + h];
        }
    }
    if (t == 0) {
        a[0] = s[0];
    }
}

int main()
{
    float* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, 256 * sizeof(float));
    for (int i {0}; i < 256; ++i) {
        a[i] = 1.0f;
    }
    tree<<<1, 256>>>(cuda::std::span<float> {a, 256});
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{:.0f}", a[0]);
    cudaFree(a);
}
```
Answer: c++23 undefined sanitizer

## Verdict 2
```cuda
#include <cuda/std/span>
#include <print>

__global__ void tree(cuda::std::span<float> a)
{
    __shared__ float s[256];
    unsigned t {threadIdx.x};
    s[t] = a[t];
    __syncthreads();
    for (unsigned h {1}; h < 256; h *= 2) {
        if (t % (2 * h) == 0) {
            s[t] += s[t + h];
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (t == 0) {
        a[0] = s[0];
    }
}

int main()
{
    float* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, 256 * sizeof(float));
    for (int i {0}; i < 256; ++i) {
        a[i] = i % 2 == 0 ? 1e8f : 1.0f;
    }
    tree<<<1, 256>>>(cuda::std::span<float> {a, 256});
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{:.0f}", a[0]);
    cudaFree(a);
}
```
Answer: c++23 defined

## Alone 1
Form: run
Write a program that reads n numbers and prints their sum, added as floats on the device in one block of n threads. Add them by this tree: for h = n/2, then n/4, and so on down to 1, element i adds element i + h, for every i < h. The sum is element 0. The tree fixes the order of the additions, so the float sum is exact text.
Input: one line, n, then one line of n integers, each read into a float.
Output: one line, the sum printed with no digits after the point, as std::println("{:.0f}", sum) prints it.
Limits: n is a power of two, 1 ≤ n ≤ 1024; each integer is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.
### Examples
```in
4
1 2 3 4
```
```out
10
```
```in
8
5 -3 7 0 2 2 -1 4
```
```out
16
```
### Reference
```cuda
#include <cuda/std/span>
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

__global__ void tree(cuda::std::span<float> a)
{
    unsigned t {threadIdx.x};
    for (unsigned h {blockDim.x / 2}; h > 0; h /= 2) {
        if (t < h) {
            a[t] += a[t + h];
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
}

int main()
{
    unsigned n {0};
    std::cin >> n;
    float* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, n * sizeof(float));
    for (unsigned i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }
    tree<<<1, n>>>(cuda::std::span<float> {a, n});
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{:.0f}", a[0]);
    cudaFree(a);
}
```

## Alone 2
Form: run
Write a program that reads n numbers and prints their sum, added as floats on the device in two rounds. In round one, each block of b threads sums its own b numbers by the tree below. Block j holds numbers j·b to j·b + b − 1. In round two, one block of n/b threads sums the block sums, in block order, by the same tree. The tree: for h = half the count, then half again, down to 1, element i adds element i + h, for every i < h; the sum is element 0.
Input: one line, n and b, then one line of n integers, each read into a float.
Output: one line, the sum printed with no digits after the point, as std::println("{:.0f}", sum) prints it.
Limits: b and n/b are powers of two, 1 ≤ b ≤ 1024, 1 ≤ n/b ≤ 1024, n ≤ 4096; each integer is between -1000000000 and 1000000000.
### Examples
```in
8 4
1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8
```
```out
36
```
```in
8 2
10 -4 3 3 0 1 2 2
```
```out
17
```
### Reference
```cuda
#include <cuda/std/span>
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

__global__ void tree(cuda::std::span<float> a,
                     cuda::std::span<float> sums)
{
    unsigned b {blockDim.x};
    cuda::std::span<float> part {a.subspan(blockIdx.x * b, b)};
    unsigned t {threadIdx.x};
    for (unsigned h {b / 2}; h > 0; h /= 2) {
        if (t < h) {
            part[t] += part[t + h];
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (t == 0) {
        sums[blockIdx.x] = part[0];
    }
}

int main()
{
    unsigned n {0};
    unsigned b {0};
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    unsigned g {n / b};
    float* a {nullptr};
    float* s {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, n * sizeof(float));
    cudaMallocManaged(&s, g * sizeof(float));
    for (unsigned i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }
    cuda::std::span<float> sums {s, g};
    tree<<<g, b>>>(cuda::std::span<float> {a, n}, sums);
    tree<<<1, g>>>(sums, sums);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{:.0f}", s[0]);
    cudaFree(a);
    cudaFree(s);
}
```
